g.text: Stage-associated mesh density needs to be separated from biological topography
Left: 42 development specimens × 4 scanners; scanner observations are correlated. Orange line = scanner median.
Right: controls fit on training specimens only; same 64-scan validation cohort. Density association does not identify its biological/acquisition cause.
